$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

inspectRequest.description: 按 scope 看文件的一部分。
inspectRequest.descriptionEn: View part of the file according to scope.
inspectRequest.limits: 不要一次要整份文件。不带 scope 只返回名单，不返回单元格。xlsx 公式格的 value 是包里的缓存，没有缓存则为 null，库不算。改内容用 apply，不要把这次看到的树整份送回去当修改。
inspectRequest.limitsEn: Do not request the whole file at once. Without scope the result is only the list, not cells. An xlsx formula cell's value is the cached value in the package; it is null when there is no cache, and the library does not calculate it. To change content, use apply. Do not send the whole tree you just saw back as the edit.

inspectScope.limits: 三种格式的键不能混用。xlsx 看格子要同时给 sheet 和 range。没列出的键不要写。
inspectScope.limitsEn: Do not mix keys from the three formats. To view xlsx cells, give both sheet and range. Do not write keys that are not listed.

createRequest.description: 整包生成一份新文件。目标路径已存在则覆盖。
createRequest.descriptionEn: Generate a whole new file. An existing path is overwritten.
createRequest.limits: 改已有内容用 apply，不要靠 create 覆盖。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不要同时写。
createRequest.limitsEn: To change existing content, use apply instead of overwriting with create. xlsx uses workbook, docx uses document, and pptx uses presentation. Do not write all three together.
createRequest.comment: path 必填。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不能同时出现。

exportMediaRequest.description: 按 id 把图或嵌入对象的原始字节写到本地。
exportMediaRequest.descriptionEn: Write the original bytes of a picture or an embedded object to a local file, by id.
exportMediaRequest.limits: 不改源文件，字节也不进 inspect 树。
exportMediaRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file, and the bytes are not placed in the inspect tree.
exportMediaRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

applyRequest.description: 用 id 和 op 改文件里点名的内容。
applyRequest.descriptionEn: Use id and op to change the named content in the file.
applyRequest.limits: 不要把整棵 inspect 树塞进请求。
applyRequest.limitsEn: Do not send the whole inspect tree back as the edit.

exportChartDataRequest.description: 把图表背后的工作簿数据导出。
exportChartDataRequest.descriptionEn: Export the workbook data behind a chart.
exportChartDataRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file and does not evaluate formulas.
exportChartDataRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

exportChartImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 工作表或图表工作表上的簇状柱形图、簇状条形图、普通（非堆积、非百分比）折线图、带标记的散点图、普通（非堆积、非百分比）面积图或普通饼图画成 PNG。
exportChartImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw a clustered column chart, a clustered bar chart, a standard (non-stacked, non-percent) line chart, a marked scatter chart, a standard (non-stacked, non-percent) area chart, or a standard pie chart, from an xlsx worksheet or chartsheet to a PNG.
exportChartImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{名称}/chart:{图 id}。工作表上的嵌入图和图表工作表上的图都认。只画簇状柱形图，簇状条形图（barChart 且 barDir 为 bar 或省略、grouping 为 clustered 或省略；数值轴在下、类目轴在左；类目 minMax 或缺省时第一类在下，maxMin 时第一类在上；正值向右、负值向左，缺值跳过该条），grouping 为 standard 或省略的 lineChart，以及 scatterStyle 为 marker 或 lineMarker（缺省按 lineMarker）的 scatterChart，还有 grouping 为 standard 或省略的 areaChart，以及恰好一条系列的 pieChart。折线只画实线；散点按 X/Y 数值坐标定位，lineMarker 画实线，缺值断开；缺省、auto 或 circle 标记画成系列色实心圆，标记 none 不画点。面积图按与折线相同的类目槽公式定位，用不透明纯色填到数值轴交叉（autoZero 为零，零在轴外时取较近端）；正值在交叉之上、负值在下，相邻异号在交叉处剖开；后画的系列盖住先画的系列；缺值按缺口断开填充。有写出的实线描边才画上沿线，不默认画标记。普通饼图没有坐标轴；firstSliceAng 缺省为 0，按从正上方起顺时针计量，360 与 0 相同；只给有限正值扇区，角度按正值之和比例分配；空值跳过扇区与图例项，零值不占角度但仍可出现在图例；varyColors 省略时视为开启，扇区按 accent 循环，dPt 上的不透明纯色可覆盖，关闭时用系列纯色。图例只画缺省右侧类目名，或没有图例。饼是绘图区内接圆。堆积、百分比堆积、可见数据标签、条形图上不是左类目/下数值的轴位、类目轴网格、平滑线、仅连线散点、虚线、其它标记符号、空值按零或连线、非数值 X/Y、半透明面积填充、三维条形、折线或面积、负值或没有有限正值的饼图、多系列饼图、三维饼、圆环、复合饼、非零爆炸、半透明或非纯色扇区、可见扇区描边、非缺省右侧类目图例、组合图及其余类型报 NotImplemented。系列优先用图里的缓存，没有时用公式所指格子里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。其余图报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。 可选 dpi 为 24 到 600 的整数；省略或 96 时保持现有 96 dpi 出图。不改源包与系统 DPI。
exportChartImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}/chart:{chart id}. Embedded worksheet charts and chartsheet charts are both accepted. Only clustered column charts, clustered bar charts (a barChart whose barDir is bar or omitted and whose grouping is clustered or omitted; value axis at the bottom, category axis on the left; the first category is at the bottom when the category orientation is minMax or omitted, and at the top when it is maxMin; positive values grow right, negative values grow left, and a missing value skips that bar), standard (non-stacked, non-percent) lineChart figures, scatterChart figures whose scatterStyle is marker or lineMarker (lineMarker when omitted), areaChart figures whose grouping is standard or omitted, and single-series pieChart figures are drawn. A line uses a solid stroke. A scatter point is placed on numeric X/Y axes; lineMarker draws a solid stroke and a missing x or y breaks it; omitted, auto, or circle markers are filled series-color circles, and symbol none draws no markers. An area uses the same category-slot formula as a line and fills an opaque solid color to the value-axis crossing (zero for autoZero, or the nearer bound when zero is outside the axis); positives fill above the crossing and negatives below, and a sign change is split at the crossing; later series cover earlier ones; a missing value breaks the fill. A solid outline is stroked only when written; markers are not drawn by default. A standard pie has no axes; firstSliceAng defaults to 0, is measured clockwise from up, and treats 360 as 0; only finite positive values get wedges, sized by their share of the positive sum; a blank skips the wedge and the legend entry; a zero takes no angle but may still appear in the legend; omitted varyColors defaults to on, cycling accents unless a dPt opaque solid fill overrides that slice, and an explicit false uses the series solid fill. Only a default-right category legend, or no legend, is drawn. The pie is the inscribed circle in the plot rectangle. Stacked and percent-stacked grouping, visible data labels, a bar chart whose axes are not category-left and value-bottom, category-axis gridlines, smoothed lines, line-only scatter, dashes, other marker symbols, blanks as zero or span, non-numeric X/Y, translucent area fills, 3-D bars, lines, or areas, a pie with a negative or no finite positive value, a multi-series pie, 3-D pie, doughnut, of-pie, a non-zero explosion, a translucent or non-solid slice fill, a visible slice outline, a non-default-right category legend, combination charts, and other types return NotImplemented. A series uses the cache in the chart, or the cached cells its formula points at when that cache is absent. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Other charts return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. Optional dpi is an integer from 24 to 600; omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi export. The source package and system DPI are not changed.
exportChartImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

dpi.description: 可选。本次栅格化的整数 DPI。省略或 96 时与现有 96 dpi 出图像素一致。只影响写出的 PNG，不改源包，也不改系统 DPI。按该 DPI 原生计算坐标、字体、描边和间距，不是先画 96 再拉伸。合法范围 24 到 600。超出 1 到 4096 的像素边长仍报 NotImplemented。
dpi.descriptionEn: Optional. Integer DPI for this rasterization. Omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi pixels. Affects only the written PNG, not the source package or system DPI. Coordinates, fonts, strokes, and spacing are computed natively at this DPI; this is not a 96 dpi bitmap stretch. Valid range is 24 to 600. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels still returns NotImplemented.

exportSparklineImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 一组里的一条折线、非负柱形或盈亏迷你图画成 PNG。合法日期轴按日期比例定位。
exportSparklineImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one line, non-negative column, or win/loss sparkline in an xlsx group to a PNG. A valid date axis is placed in date proportion.
exportSparklineImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{name}/spark:{n}。一组只能有一条，落点只能是一个格子。折线可以画。柱形只在每个点都是非负数、没有空格子时画。高点、低点、首点和末点换成纯色，同一根柱按低点、高点、首点、末点留第一种。盈亏（type=stacked）可以画，空与 0 不画柱。dateAxis 打开且组上 xm:f 是与数值等长的单行或单列有限日期序列时，等距日期仍放到分类轴同一套槽公式上、与关闭日期轴像素一致；不等距日期按最小到最大的连续比例定位（96 dpi 左右各留 12 像素，右沿为 width-1-left），不排序、不映射到分类槽。日期缺失、非数值、长度不合、二维区域，或至少两点但全部日期相同，报 NotImplemented，不回退成等距分类轴。折线上的标记和这些点、柱形的负值、横坐标、从右到左、柱形上的空格子、盈亏的 span、自定义轴，报 NotImplemented。数值用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。宽或高超出能画的范围也报 NotImplemented。 可选 dpi 为 24 到 600 的整数；省略或 96 时保持现有 96 dpi 出图。不改源包与系统 DPI。
exportSparklineImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}/spark:{n}. The group must hold one sparkline, and the location must be one cell. A line can be drawn. A column is drawn only when every point is non-negative and present. High, low, first, and last points use a solid color, and one bar keeps the first match in that order. A win/loss (type=stacked) can be drawn; empty and zero slots stay blank. When dateAxis is on and the group xm:f is a single row or column of finite dates the same length as the values, equally spaced dates stay on the category-slot formula and match a category axis; uneven dates are placed in min-to-max continuous proportion (12 px inset at 96 dpi, right edge width-1-left) and are not sorted or mapped onto category slots. Missing, non-numeric, two-dimensional, or length-mismatched dates, or identical dates when there are at least two points, return NotImplemented and do not fall back to equally spaced categories. Those points on a line, a negative column, the axis, right-to-left, an empty column cell, stacked span, and a custom axis return NotImplemented. Values come from caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Width or height outside the drawable range also returns NotImplemented. Optional dpi is an integer from 24 to 600; omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi export. The source package and system DPI are not changed.
exportSparklineImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

dpi.description: 可选。本次栅格化的整数 DPI。省略或 96 时与现有 96 dpi 出图像素一致。只影响写出的 PNG，不改源包，也不改系统 DPI。按该 DPI 原生计算坐标、字体、描边和间距，不是先画 96 再拉伸。合法范围 24 到 600。超出 1 到 4096 的像素边长仍报 NotImplemented。
dpi.descriptionEn: Optional. Integer DPI for this rasterization. Omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi pixels. Affects only the written PNG, not the source package or system DPI. Coordinates, fonts, strokes, and spacing are computed natively at this DPI; this is not a 96 dpi bitmap stretch. Valid range is 24 to 600. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels still returns NotImplemented.

exportSheetImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 工作表的已用区域画成 PNG。图表工作表没有格子，改为导出该表上那一张已会画的图。
exportSheetImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx worksheet's used range to a PNG. A chartsheet has no cells; its one already-supported chart is drawn instead.
exportSheetImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{名称}。图表工作表没有已用区域，按 exportChartImage 同一套规则导出该表上那一张图；目前只画簇状柱形图，簇状条形图（barDir 为 bar 或省略、grouping 为 clustered 或省略），grouping 为 standard 或省略的 lineChart，scatterStyle 为 marker 或 lineMarker 的 scatterChart（实线或仅标记，缺省/auto/circle 标记，空值缺口断线），以及 grouping 为 standard 或省略的 areaChart（不透明纯色填到数值轴交叉，缺值缺口），还有恰好一条系列的 pieChart（从正上方起顺时针，只给有限正值扇区，缺省右侧类目图例）；堆积、百分比、可见数据标签、条形图上不是左类目/下数值的轴位、平滑、仅连线散点、虚线、其它标记、空值按零或连线、非数值 X/Y、半透明面积填充及其余类型报 NotImplemented。不把尚未会画的类型算作通过。图画 dimension 和格子外框的并集，只有一边时用那一边。像素按 Excel 复制为图片的 100% 格子，不乘工作表缩放。显式列宽用 floor(((256*宽度+floor(128/7))/256)*7)，缺省列 64 像素。行高把磅截成像素。没写 defaultRowHeight 时，空行是 14.25 磅（19 像素）。写了该属性但 customHeight 不是真时，不采用这个数字，空行按常规样式的行高。customHeight 为真时，空行和常规字体的行用写下的磅值。合并盖住的空行按锚点的字加高。自动行高只认微软雅黑一类字体乘 1.65，以及 Calibri 11 磅为 15 磅。宽高是各格之和再加 1。网格色 E0E0E0。纯色填充盖住格子右缘和下缘。上边和左边的外框保持网格色。showGridLines 为 0 或 false 时不画网格，外框留白，宽高不变。隐藏行和隐藏列不占像素，整边隐藏时这一边只留 1 像素白。条件格式碰到隐藏行列仍报 NotImplemented。rightToLeft 且没有文字、条件格式、自动筛选时整图水平翻转，有文字时仍报 NotImplemented。公式有缓存时用缓存，没有缓存时用库里的求值。合并单元格用锚点。数据条按最小最大、长度 10% 到 90%。两档或三档色阶按 RGB 混合。expression 公式能求值且差分是纯色时铺上该色，求不了报 NotImplemented。timePeriod 用规则里的公式，按 expression 同一套求值，纯色铺上。没有公式、求不了或带差分边框报 NotImplemented。公式差分里已对齐的线型按格子边框画。expression 的 dashed 和 slantDashDot 差分边框与格子共用绘制；cellIs 带边框和差分对角线仍报 NotImplemented。高于平均、前 N 和包含文本命中后铺纯色，标准差按总体算。重复值和唯一值按规则铺纯色。空白只认锚点上的 LEN(TRIM(锚点))=0 或 >0，错误值只认 ISERROR(锚点) 或 NOT(ISERROR(锚点))。没有公式不铺，别的公式报 NotImplemented。错误文字的字色和底色不同也报 NotImplemented，没写 patternType 只有 bgColor 的差分填充也当纯色。能看成数字的文字在格子左上角画 6 像素绿三角。单元格文字按 general/left/center/right 及已交付的换行、缩进画，测宽与绘制用 Face::width，不搬 Word typo_width。水平 justify 在没有软换行、没有缩进、且不是数字或布尔时按左对齐画；水平 distributed 仅当每一行恰好两个单词时左右顶齐，缩进同时加在两侧。非 0 的 textRotation（含 255 堆积）、shrinkToFit、justifyLastLine、软换行或带缩进的 justify、不是恰好两词的 distributed、fill、centerContinuous、垂直 justify/distributed 仍报 NotImplemented。未用到的样式里有非 0 旋转不因此整表失败。筛选按钮 17×17，箭头居中。实线边框认 thin、medium、thick，各 1、2、3 像素，字色、填充和边框认 rgb、主题色和索引色，没写颜色时用黑色。边框只画在写下它的那一格上，不沿合并区扩开，合并区内部的边不画。线以边界为中线，偶数宽度多出的一像素落在坐标较小的一侧。线只伸到实际有边的那一端。更粗的线盖住交界。同样粗时右边缘盖住左边缘。更细的底边才让开左边那格：虚线让开全部厚度，实线让开一半。2 像素虚线的边界行再向右涂 1 像素。上面那一格有底边，或格子自己有上边时，竖线不涂上边界。两边都没有时，竖线从上边界涂起。虚线、点线、发丝、双线、点划线和斜点划线按整图坐标取余，发丝涂在偶数坐标，dashed 用 x 加 y 取余且余数不是 3 时涂上（横竖相同，不再对竖线做 y 减 1），双线空出边界像素。两种纯色的图案按整图像素铺在填充矩形上，前景是点，背景是底，没写前景用黑，没写背景用白。认 gray125、gray0625、横竖线、网格、三种灰度、斜向和格纹。图案色的 rgb 前两位不是 FF 时不认。没有描边、没有字的纯色矩形按锚点画，上边和左边的外框盖住它。没有颜色变换的 schemeClr 用主题部件里的那一档。没有主题部件或带了颜色变换报 NotImplemented。只含这种矩形的组合，锚点外接矩形和转完、翻完后的组外框按像素重合时也画。可以跨格、按整数比例缩放，也可以水平、垂直翻转。子矩形也可以绕自己的中心转 90 度的倍数。子矩形的水平或垂直翻转不改变这块纯色。组合可以再套一层，换算从内到外。里层也可以绕中心转 90 度。里层和外层可以同时绕中心转 90 度。锚点组合还可以绕中心转非直角：先按整数比例缩放并翻转，把未旋转外框对到 twoCell 外接框后再绕中心顺时针旋转，用公开 GDI+ 画真实旋转矩形，不拿外接框铺色。直角倍数仍走原整数路径。子矩形自己的非直角、里层组合的非直角，或 GDI+ 不可用，报 NotImplemented。不透明 PNG 在目标像素正好等于要贴的像素时按原图贴上。srcRect 落到整像素且不缩放时贴这一块，百分比落在像素中间或还要缩放报 NotImplemented。直角倍数的旋转，以及水平或垂直翻转，按锚点外接矩形铺纯色。其它角度、描边和半透明报 NotImplemented。其它压到区域上的图形、斜线、渐变填充、认不出的图案、条件格式里的图案和其它条件格式报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。 可选 dpi 为 24 到 600 的整数；省略或 96 时保持现有 96 dpi 出图。不改源包与系统 DPI。
exportSheetImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}. A chartsheet has no used range; its one chart is drawn with the same rules as exportChartImage. Only clustered column charts, clustered bar charts (barDir bar or omitted, clustered grouping), standard (non-stacked, non-percent) lineChart figures, marked scatterChart figures (marker or lineMarker), standard (non-stacked, non-percent) areaChart figures (opaque fill to the value-axis crossing, gap blanks), and single-series pieChart figures (clockwise from up, positive values only, default-right category legend) are drawn; stacked, percent, visible data labels, a bar chart whose axes are not category-left and value-bottom, smooth, line-only scatter, dashed, other markers, blanks as zero or span, non-numeric X/Y, translucent area fills, unsupported pie details, and other types return NotImplemented. A chart type that is not yet drawn is not counted as a pass. The picture is the union of the dimension and the cell bounding box, or whichever one is present. Pixels follow Excel CopyPicture at 100 percent and do not multiply the sheet zoom. An explicit column width uses floor(((256*width+floor(128/7))/256)*7). An omitted column is 64 pixels. Row height truncates points to pixels. With no defaultRowHeight, an empty row is 14.25 pt (19 pixels). A written height is ignored unless customHeight is true, and an empty row then uses the Normal style. When customHeight is true, empty rows and Normal-font rows use that height. An empty row inside a merge grows with the anchor font. Automatic row height only treats CJK faces as 1.65 times the point size, and Calibri 11 pt as 15 pt. Width and height are the sums plus 1. The grid is E0E0E0. Solid fills cover the cell's right and bottom edges. The top and left outer frame stay the grid color. When showGridLines is 0 or false, the grid is not drawn, the frame stays white, and the size does not change. Hidden rows and columns take no pixels. When a whole side is hidden, that side is one white pixel. A conditional format that touches a hidden row or column still returns NotImplemented. When rightToLeft is set and there is no text, conditional format, or auto filter, the picture is flipped horizontally. Text still returns NotImplemented. A formula with a cache uses that cache. A formula without a cache uses the library evaluator. A merge uses its anchor. Data bars use min and max, from 10 percent to 90 percent. Two or three color-scale stops mix in RGB. An expression rule with a solid differential fills the cell when the formula evaluates to a non-zero value. A formula that cannot be evaluated returns NotImplemented. A timePeriod rule uses the formula stored on the rule, shifted like an expression, and a solid differential fills the cell. A missing formula, a formula that cannot be evaluated, or a differential border returns NotImplemented. A formula differential border is painted like a cell border when that line style already matches. expression dashed and slantDashDot differential borders use the same paint path as cell borders; cellIs-with-border and differential diagonals still return NotImplemented. Above-average, top-N, and text rules paint a solid fill on the cells they hit. The standard deviation is the population figure. Duplicate and unique rules paint a solid fill. Blank rules accept only LEN(TRIM(anchor))=0 or >0 at the anchor. Error rules accept only ISERROR(anchor) or NOT(ISERROR(anchor)). A missing formula paints nothing, and any other formula is NotImplemented. Error text whose color differs from the fill is NotImplemented. A differential fill with only bgColor and no patternType is also solid. Text that parses as a number gets a 6-pixel green triangle at the top-left of the cell. Cell text is painted with general, left, center, or right alignment, and with the already delivered wrap and indent rules; measure and draw use Face::width, not Word typo_width. Horizontal justify is painted as left when no line is soft-wrapped, indent is 0, and the value is not a number or boolean. Horizontal distributed is painted only when every line has exactly two words, flush to the left and right insets, with indent applied on both sides. A non-zero textRotation (including stacked 255), shrinkToFit, justifyLastLine, justify that soft-wraps or has indent, distributed lines that are not exactly two words, fill, centerContinuous, and vertical justify or distributed still return NotImplemented. An unused style with a non-zero rotation does not fail the sheet. Filter buttons are 17 by 17, with the arrow centered. Solid borders accept thin, medium, and thick, at 1, 2, and 3 pixels. Font, fill, and border colors accept rgb, a theme color, or an indexed color. A missing color is black. A border stays on the cell that has it, is not stretched around a merge, and an edge inside the merge is not drawn. The line is centered on the cell edge. An even width puts the extra pixel toward the smaller coordinate. A line stops at an end that has no border. A thicker line covers a thinner one on the same edge. At the same thickness, a right edge covers a left edge. A thinner bottom edge leaves room for the cell on its left: the full thickness after a dashed line, and half after a solid line. A two-pixel dash paints one more pixel to the right on the boundary row. A vertical line leaves the top boundary unpainted when the cell above has a bottom edge or this cell has a top edge, and paints the top boundary when neither exists. Dashed, dotted, hair, double, dash-dot, and slant-dash-dot lines follow the picture coordinate. Hair is on even coordinates. A dashed line uses x plus y and paints when the remainder is not 3 (same for horizontal and vertical; no y minus 1 on vertical lines). A double line leaves the boundary pixel blank. A two-color pattern uses the same rectangle as a solid fill and the picture's pixel coordinates. The foreground is the dot and the background is the field. A missing foreground is black and a missing background is white. Recognized patterns are gray125, gray0625, horizontal and vertical lines, grids, the three grays, diagonals, and trellises. A pattern rgb whose first two digits are not FF is rejected. A solid rectangle with no line and no text is drawn from its anchor. The top and left frame covers it. A schemeClr with no color transform uses that slot from the theme part. A missing theme part, or a color transform, is NotImplemented. A group of those rectangles is drawn when its anchor box matches the group box in pixels after the group's turn or flip. It may cross cells and scale by an integer ratio. A child rectangle may also turn by a multiple of 90 degrees around its own center. A horizontal or vertical flip on that solid rectangle does not change its pixels. A group may contain another group, mapped from the inside out. The inner group may also turn by a multiple of 90 degrees. The inner and outer groups may both turn by 90 degrees. An anchor group may also turn by a non-right angle: it is scaled by the integer-ratio map, flipped, then mapped into the twoCell AABB as the unrotated destination and rotated clockwise around the group-box center, and painted with public GDI+ as a real rotated rectangle, not by filling the bounding box. Quarter turns still use the existing integer path. A non-right angle on a child rectangle or an inner group, or a missing GDI+ device, is NotImplemented. An opaque PNG is copied when the destination box equals the pixels being copied. An srcRect that lands on whole pixels and does not scale copies that window. A percentage between pixels, or a crop that still scales, is NotImplemented. A quarter-turn rotation, or a horizontal or vertical flip, paints the anchor's axis-aligned box. Another angle, a stroke, or partial alpha is NotImplemented. Other drawings that hit the range, diagonal borders, gradient fills, unrecognized patterns, patterns inside conditional formats, and other conditional formats return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Optional dpi is an integer from 24 to 600; omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi export. The source package and system DPI are not changed.
exportSheetImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

dpi.description: 可选。本次栅格化的整数 DPI。省略或 96 时与现有 96 dpi 出图像素一致。只影响写出的 PNG，不改源包，也不改系统 DPI。按该 DPI 原生计算坐标、字体、描边和间距，不是先画 96 再拉伸。合法范围 24 到 600。超出 1 到 4096 的像素边长仍报 NotImplemented。
dpi.descriptionEn: Optional. Integer DPI for this rasterization. Omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi pixels. Affects only the written PNG, not the source package or system DPI. Coordinates, fonts, strokes, and spacing are computed natively at this DPI; this is not a 96 dpi bitmap stretch. Valid range is 24 to 600. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels still returns NotImplemented.

exportPageImageRequest.description: 把 docx 的一页画成 PNG。
exportPageImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one docx page to a PNG.
exportPageImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 page:N，从 1 起。已画：单节；空页；拉丁 Calibri 多段（换行/段距/缩进）；extent 像素与源一致的不透明 inline PNG（无缩放）；表（单元格填色、single/nil 边、tblGrid/tblInd/trHeight、默认单元格边距、表内拉丁 Calibri）；default 页眉拉丁 Calibri（pgMar/@header，正文原点不位移）。宽高按 w:pgSz，按请求 DPI 将 twip×dpi/1440 四舍五入（96 dpi 时与现有 twip×96/1440 像素一致），要落在 1 到 4096 像素。磅按磅×dpi/72 换算；嵌入图 extent 按 EMU×dpi/914400 截断，与历史 96 dpi 截断一致。不要套用 Excel 先按 96 量化再放大的行高规则。浮动绕排、裁剪、透明、文图混排、缩放图、合并/表样式、奇偶/首页页眉、页脚、页眉内图/表/域与显式行距/分页控制报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。可选 dpi 为 24 到 600 的整数；省略或 96 时保持现有 96 dpi 出图。不改源包与系统 DPI。
exportPageImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is page:N, starting at 1. Drawn: one section; empty pages; Latin Calibri paragraphs (wrap/spacing/indent); opaque inline PNG whose extent pixels match the source (no scale); tables (cell fill, single/nil borders, tblGrid/tblInd/trHeight, default cell margins, Latin Calibri cell text); default header Latin Calibri (pgMar/@header; body origin unchanged). Width and height come from w:pgSz at the requested DPI, rounding twip times dpi/1440 (at 96 dpi this matches the existing twip times 96/1440 pixels), and must be 1 to 4096 pixels. Points use pt times dpi/72. Embedded picture extents truncate EMU times dpi/914400, matching the historical 96 dpi truncation. Do not apply Excel's 96-first row-height quantization. Floating wrap, crop, transparency, mixed text+picture, scaled pictures, merged cells / table styles, even/first headers, footers, header images/tables/fields, and explicit line/pagination controls return NotImplemented. xlsx and pptx return InvalidField. Optional dpi is an integer from 24 to 600; omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi export. The source package and system DPI are not changed.
exportPageImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

dpi.description: 可选。本次栅格化的整数 DPI。省略或 96 时与现有 96 dpi 出图像素一致。只影响写出的 PNG，不改源包，也不改系统 DPI。按该 DPI 原生计算坐标、字体、描边和间距，不是先画 96 再拉伸。合法范围 24 到 600。超出 1 到 4096 的像素边长仍报 NotImplemented。
dpi.descriptionEn: Optional. Integer DPI for this rasterization. Omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi pixels. Affects only the written PNG, not the source package or system DPI. Coordinates, fonts, strokes, and spacing are computed natively at this DPI; this is not a 96 dpi bitmap stretch. Valid range is 24 to 600. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels still returns NotImplemented.

exportSlideImageRequest.description: 按幻灯片 id 把页底、PNG、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、两色直线渐变、形状图片填充、形状文字、簇状柱形图、簇状条形图、普通折线图、带标记的散点图、普通面积图、普通饼图和纯色单元格的表写成 PNG。
exportSlideImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw a pptx slide's background, PNG pictures, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, two-stop linear gradients, shape image fills, shape text, clustered column charts, clustered bar charts, standard line charts, marked scatter charts, standard area charts, standard pie charts, and solid table cells to a PNG.
exportSlideImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。页底用本页、版式或母版上没有颜色变换的不透明纯色（含主题色），或不透明的两停点直角线性渐变；没有或画不了时铺白。半透明、路径、非直角或主题 bgRef 渐变仍铺白。还画没有旋转的 PNG、整像素且不缩放的裁剪、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、形状里的文字（含段落里 a:br 换行后的后续行）、簇状柱形图、簇状条形图、普通折线图、带标记的散点图、普通面积图、普通饼图和纯色单元格的表。这些对象放在组合里、母版上和版式上也画。两色直线渐变画在没有旋转的矩形、圆角矩形和椭圆上，两档可以带 alpha，半透明会叠在已画像素上。两停点、直角、不透明的线性页底按同一条 Office 16.0 S 形曲线铺满整页。矩形上的渐变仍不能带描边。形状上的 blipFill 会按拉伸铺进没有旋转的矩形、圆角矩形和椭圆；平铺、fillRect 偏移、对不齐的裁剪、非 PNG、带颜色变换的 blip，或矩形上还带描边，让整页失败，不再静默跳过。p:pic 图片会画。画不了的对象让整页失败。宽高按 p:sldSz 的 EMU 以请求 DPI 四舍五入（EMU×dpi/914400；96 dpi 时与现有像素一致），不是先按 96 量化再放大。磅按磅×dpi/72。不要套用 Excel 先按 96 量化再放大的行高规则。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 docx 报 InvalidField。可选 dpi 为 24 到 600 的整数；省略或 96 时保持现有 96 dpi 出图。不改源包与系统 DPI。
exportSlideImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Opaque solid page backgrounds without a color transform, including theme colors, come from the slide, then the layout, then the master. An opaque two-stop right-angle linear page gradient is drawn with the same Office 16.0 S-curve as shape gradients. Missing, unrecognized, translucent, path, non-right-angle, or theme bgRef gradients stay white. Unrotated PNG pictures, crops that stay on whole pixels and keep the same size, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, shape text (including later lines after an a:br), clustered column charts, clustered bar charts, standard line charts, marked scatter charts, standard area charts, standard pie charts, and solid table cells are drawn, including inside groups and on the master or layout. A two-stop linear gradient is drawn on an unrotated rectangle, rounded rectangle, or ellipse, and the stops may include alpha; translucent stops composite over pixels already drawn. A gradient on a rectangle still cannot have a stroke. A stretched shape blipFill is painted on an unrotated rectangle, rounded rectangle, or ellipse; tiling, a fillRect offset, a crop that does not stay on whole pixels, a non-PNG image, a color transform on the blip, or a stroked rectangle blipFill fails the slide rather than being skipped. p:pic pictures are drawn. An object that cannot be drawn fails the slide. Width and height come from p:sldSz EMU rounded at the requested DPI (EMU times dpi/914400; at 96 dpi this matches the existing pixels), not by quantizing at 96 and scaling up. Points use pt times dpi/72. Do not apply Excel's 96-first row-height quantization. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. xlsx and docx return InvalidField. Optional dpi is an integer from 24 to 600; omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi export. The source package and system DPI are not changed.
exportSlideImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

dpi.description: 可选。本次栅格化的整数 DPI。省略或 96 时与现有 96 dpi 出图像素一致。只影响写出的 PNG，不改源包，也不改系统 DPI。按该 DPI 原生计算坐标、字体、描边和间距，不是先画 96 再拉伸。合法范围 24 到 600。超出 1 到 4096 的像素边长仍报 NotImplemented。
dpi.descriptionEn: Optional. Integer DPI for this rasterization. Omitted or 96 keeps the existing 96 dpi pixels. Affects only the written PNG, not the source package or system DPI. Coordinates, fonts, strokes, and spacing are computed natively at this DPI; this is not a 96 dpi bitmap stretch. Valid range is 24 to 600. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels still returns NotImplemented.

layoutCheckRequest.description: 只读检查页上形状的几何，不改文件。
layoutCheckRequest.descriptionEn: Check shape geometry on slides without changing the file.
layoutCheckRequest.limits: 不生成图片，不调用 Office，不重排。本期只做 pptx，其余格式报 InvalidField。
layoutCheckRequest.limitsEn: No images, no Office calls, no reflow. Only pptx is supported in this phase; other formats return InvalidField.

helpRequest.descriptionEn: Look up how to fill in an operation.
helpRequest.limits: 先搜再打开。不要猜字段，也不要把别的格式的字段套过来。本工具不支持预览。xlsx 的簇状柱形图、簇状条形图、普通折线图、带标记的散点图、普通面积图和普通饼图可以按 exportChartImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的折线、非负柱形和盈亏迷你图可以按 exportSparklineImage 写成 PNG，合法日期轴按日期比例定位。xlsx 的已用区域可以按 exportSheetImage 写成 PNG。pptx 可以按 exportSlideImage 把页底、PNG、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、两色直线渐变、形状文字、簇状柱形图、簇状条形图、普通折线图、带标记的散点图、普通面积图、普通饼图和纯色单元格的表写成图。两色直线渐变画在没有旋转的矩形、圆角矩形和椭圆上，两档可以带 alpha。形状上的 blipFill 会按拉伸铺进这些形状；画不了的变体让整页失败，不再静默跳过。create 把文本里的换行写成 a:br 时，预览器也会画出后续行。画不了的对象让整页失败。docx 可以按 exportPageImage 把单节空页、拉丁 Calibri 多段、不缩放的不透明 inline PNG、表（含表内拉丁 Calibri）和 default 页眉写成 PNG。画不了的内容让整页失败。像素不进 inspect。机器上有 Microsoft Office 或 WPS 时，可以自己导出后再查看：Word、Excel，以及 WPS 的 kwps、ket，用 ExportAsFixedFormat 写成 PDF；PowerPoint 和 WPS 的 kwpp 用幻灯片的 Export 写成 PNG。本工具不调用它们。
helpRequest.limitsEn: Search first, then open one operation. Do not guess fields, and do not reuse fields from another format. This tool does not preview a whole page. An xlsx clustered column, clustered bar, standard line, marked scatter, standard area, or standard pie chart can be written to PNG with exportChartImage. An xlsx line, non-negative column, or win/loss sparkline can be written to PNG with exportSparklineImage, with a valid date axis placed in date proportion. An xlsx used range can be written to PNG with exportSheetImage. A pptx slide's background, PNG pictures, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, two-stop linear gradients, shape text, clustered column charts, clustered bar charts, standard line charts, marked scatter charts, standard area charts, standard pie charts, and solid table cells can be written with exportSlideImage. Two-stop linear gradients are drawn on an unrotated rectangle, rounded rectangle, or ellipse, and the stops may include alpha. A stretched shape blipFill is painted on those shapes; a variant that cannot be drawn fails the slide rather than being skipped. When create writes a newline as a:br, the previewer also paints the later lines. An object that cannot be drawn fails the slide. Those pixels do not enter inspect. A docx page can be written to PNG with exportPageImage when it is a single section with empty pages, Latin Calibri paragraphs, an unscaled opaque inline PNG, a table (including Latin Calibri cell text), and/or a default header. Content that cannot be drawn fails the page. If Microsoft Office or WPS is installed, export and then look: Word, Excel, and WPS kwps and ket use ExportAsFixedFormat to write a PDF; PowerPoint and WPS kwpp use the slide Export method to write a PNG. This tool does not call them.
